title: Observed native operations and same-text fidelity repairs

scenes.title: focus-scale-edit
lines: Before reading focus regions, inspect what becomes blurred in the ordinary view. Use the cube arrangement to distinguish near and far edges. The Scale control changes the amount of blur. This is a historical2017 Bokeh demonstration; its value is not a physical camera f-stop.

scenes.title: focus-layers-entry
lines: Visible blur alone does not identify the responsible distance region. The visualization menu therefore leads to a focus-region display. Once diagnostic colors and their legend appear, distinguish them from material colors. We can then inspect the focus reference and the boundaries around it.

scenes.title: debugger-command-submit
lines: Before frame inspection, briefly follow the code that submits drawing commands. Distinguish the debugger’s yellow current-line mark from the caller list below it. The source connects closing a command list with requesting execution. A CPU paused on this line does not establish GPU completion.

scenes.title: focus-to-frame-inspection
lines: We compared final appearance in four games with editor exposure, color and focus controls. We can observe changes, but identifying which command read which resource is another question. Frame inspection now follows actual inputs and outputs rather than relying on feature names.

scenes.title: resource-name-limits
lines: After locating a name, inspect dimensions and usage. Lumen radiance data and shadow data should not be collapsed into one generic light resource. Names start the investigation; producers and consumers complete it. This viewer alone does not verify every dependency in the frame.
